sources.entry: ShinyMac - Open-source SwiftUI Mac cleaner with one-scan Smart Care, an app uninstaller that finds leftovers, Xcode cleanup, a Space Lens disk map and hidden settings. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/pballada/shinyMac) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: ShinyMac is a free, open-source native SwiftUI cleaner for macOS that removes junk, fully uninstalls apps, and provides disk-space and system-tuning tools.
keywords: free up disk space on mac
summary.what_it_does: ShinyMac is a macOS app built in SwiftUI that scans for and removes junk files, including user caches, logs, Xcode DerivedData and simulators, and package-manager caches such as Homebrew, npm, pip and Gradle. Its Smart Care mode runs a single scan and cleanup pass, empties the Trash and runs maintenance tasks, then flags updates, leftovers and large files for review. The Uninstaller removes an app along with the files it leaves across 22 Library locations, and its Leftovers module finds support files from apps already deleted. Other modules cover Cloud Cleanup for files downloaded from cloud drives, Privacy (browser history and cookies, never passwords or bookmarks), App Permissions, Login Items, Duplicates (SHA-256 verified), Large and Old Files, and Space Lens, an interactive sunburst disk map. It also includes a Shredder for immediate deletion, a menu bar monitor for CPU, memory, disk, battery and network, and a Hidden Settings panel for macOS options that have no switch in System Settings. Most removals go to the Trash by default, and a SafetyGuard blocks changes to system folders.
use_cases: clean junk and caches off a Mac
completely uninstall an app and its leftover files
find out what is filling up disk space
clear Xcode derived data and simulators
review large and duplicate files before deleting
tune hidden macOS settings from a GUI
monitor CPU, memory and disk from the menu bar
notable: Smart Care runs a one-scan, one-click cleanup across several tasks
Uninstaller covers 22 Library locations and has a Reset option that keeps the app
Space Lens provides an interactive sunburst disk map
Most deletions go to the Trash, with a SafetyGuard that blocks system folders
Cloud Cleanup flags files untouched for 6 months and keeps them in the cloud
caveats: Full Disk Access must be granted manually for a complete scan of Safari data, Mail downloads, the Trash and some caches
Building from source requires Xcode 26 or later
Ad-hoc signed CI builds need right-click Open on first launch
